# Relay

> Relay is GrayCodeAI's universal LLM provider runtime: one interface for
> every model. Authentication, routing, streaming, retries, rate limiting, and
> caching are handled — your app never talks to an LLM API directly; relay
> does. It is an independent, host-neutral open-source Go library, consumed as
> the module `github.com/GrayCodeAI/relay`. Hosts own product UX and semantics;
> relay owns credentials, catalog and route resolution, provider transports,
> normalized streams, retry/fallback, usage, and provider telemetry. Read this
> file first, then AGENTS.md for working conventions and pitfalls.

## When to use Relay

- Reach for Relay when a Go application needs model access: credentials,
  routing, streaming, retries, rate limiting and caching handled behind one
  interface, across many providers.
- When you are building a host product (an agent, an IDE, a pipeline) and
  want provider choice to be a config change, not a refactor — hosts stay on
  the stable `engine/` facade.
- When you need normalized usage and cost telemetry across providers that
  each report differently.

Not the right tool for: a coding agent or any product UX — hosts own those
(Reflect is one host); or a hosted multi-tenant LLM gateway — Relay is a Go
library you embed, with your keys, in your process (an optional HTTP API
server exists under `internal/api` for embedding scenarios).

## Host boundary

- Hosts use the `engine/` facade ONLY (`engine.ContractVersion == "2"`) plus
  three sibling contract packages: hosts may import exactly `engine`, `llm`,
  `graph`, and `tools`. Everything else is engine-internal.
- Hosts must never assemble `provider`, `catalog`, `config`, `credentials`,
  `router`, `runtime` (or `setup`) directly. Lower-level packages stay public
  for non-host consumers and staged migration, but they are not the host
  contract.
- The frozen set of engine-internal symbols reachable through the facade
  (`credentials.Store`/`MapStore`, `operationsgraph.Input`/`Export`, the
  `provider/resilience` rate-limit config, `provider/cache.CacheConfig`) is
  listed in docs/architecture/HOST-ENGINE-BOUNDARY.md and enforced by
  `engine/host_surface_test.go`: the test fails whenever the reachable set
  changes. Changing that set is a deliberate API change — update the test's
  list and the doc together, deliberately.
- Six symbols hosts need (`ChatOptions`, `ContinuationConfig`, `StreamResult`,
  `ResponseFormat`, `ImageURLPart`, `InputAudioPart`) live in `llm` with no
  `engine` alias; widening the facade to cover them is likewise a deliberate
  API change, not an incidental one.
- The dependency is one-way: relay never imports its hosts. Reflect
  (github.com/GrayCodeAI/reflect) is one host, with its own repo, build, and
  release.

## Repository map

- `engine/` — stable host facade: `engine.New(engine.Options{...})`, Resolve,
  Generate/Stream, catalog, credentials, selection, health, preflight;
  re-exports `llm` types.
- `llm/` — host-facing DTOs and the `llm.Provider` port (a composition of role
  interfaces) that `engine` re-exports.
- `graph/` — portable execution-graph vocabulary.
- `tools/` — tool-call and tool-result contracts.
- `provider/` — provider runtime composition root: `RelayClient` construction,
  chat orchestration, options; subpackages below.
- `provider/core/` — provider-neutral wire types, transport, SSE stream, and
  retry primitives (`Provider`, `RelayConfig`, `RelayMessage`, `RelayError`).
- `provider/adapters/` — per-provider protocol adapters (anthropic, openai,
  gemini, bedrock, vertex, azure, ollama, ...) plus the construction registry
  (`provider_registry.go`) and compat configs (`OpenAICompat`, `GrokCompat`,
  `OpenRouterCompat`).
- `credentials/` — API key storage and lookup (OS keyring, env, in-memory
  stores), OIDC keyless auth, safe status projection.
- `catalog/` — model catalog: pricing, context windows, capabilities, tiers,
  deprecation; `catalog/registry/providers.go` is the single source of truth
  for the 29 provider gateways.
- `router/`, `runtime/` — routing strategies, deployment fallback chains,
  circuit breakers, controlplane; engine-internal provider/model/credential
  resolution and preflight.
- `types/` — shared message types and API error constants.
- `operationsgraph/` — privacy-safe route and generation telemetry projection
  (SHA-256 digests only).
- `internal/` — helpers hosts cannot import: HTTP API server (`internal/api`),
  optional gRPC transport (build tag `grpc`), health, cache, observability,
  language SDKs.

## Provider surface

- Provider interface: `provider/core.Provider` with `Chat()`, `StreamChat()`,
  `Ping()`, `Name()`.
- Client creation: `provider.NewRelayClient(&core.RelayConfig{...})` or
  `provider.Client(...)`; `RelayConfig` carries `Provider`, `APIKey`,
  `BaseURL`, `Model`, `MaxRetries`.
- Auto-detection: `DetectProvider()` picks a provider from env vars in
  priority order (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, ...) when none is
  pinned.
- Streaming: `c.StreamChat(ctx, messages, opts)` returns `*StreamResult`; the
  caller must `defer sr.Close()`. Streaming is SSE-based (`parseSSEStream()`).
- Auto-continuation: `StreamChatContinue()` transparently continues when
  `stop_reason == max_tokens`; also `ChatWithContinuation(...,
  core.DefaultContinuationConfig())`.
- Fallback chains: `router/router.go` (provider fallback) and
  `router/deployment_router.go` (deployment stages) for high availability.
- Rate limiting: token bucket per provider (`provider/resilience/ratelimit.go`)
  to stay under API limits.
- Caching: response cache with configurable TTL plus semantic-similarity
  caching (`provider/cache/semantic_cache.go`).
- Retry: `provider/core/retry.go` — exponential backoff with jitter, honors
  `Retry-After`, retries on 429/500/502/503/529.
- Errors: `RelayError` (`Provider`, `Op`, `StatusCode`, `RequestID`,
  `Message`, `Err`) with `IsRetriable()`, `IsAuthError()`, `IsRateLimited()`.
- Adding a provider: implement `Provider`, add the adapter under
  `provider/adapters/`, register it in
  `provider/adapters/provider_registry.go`, and add the gateway to
  `catalog/registry/providers.go` (README and `.env.example` must match;
  `catalog/registry/docs_test.go` fails on drift).
- Mocks: `provider/testkit/mock.go` provides offline mock providers for tests.

## Verification

- `go test ./...` — all tests; `go test -race ./...` adds the race detector.
- `go vet ./...` — static analysis.
- `gofumpt` (plus `goimports`) formatting is enforced in CI; run `make fmt`.
- `make ci` — the full gate: version-check, tidy, fmt, vet, golangci-lint,
  boundary scripts, replace-directive check, race tests, govulncheck.
- Tests are table-driven; provider tests use `httptest.NewServer` mock LLM
  APIs (create mock server, point the client at it, call Chat/StreamChat,
  assert headers and events). Streaming tests need careful goroutine
  management.
- `make check-replace` runs `scripts/check-no-replace-directives.sh`: no
  local `replace` directives in go.mod.

## Guardrails

Do not touch (breaking for every consumer):
- The `Provider` interface (`Chat`, `StreamChat`, `Ping`, `Name`).
- `RelayMessage` / `RelayResponse` / `ChatOptions` field names — serialization
  contract.
- The `RelayError` struct — consumers assert on its type.
- `provider/core.RelayConfig` — constructor contract for all consumers.
- The frozen engine-internal symbols and `llm`-only symbols listed under
  Host boundary.

Safe to extend: new provider adapters, new SSE event types, new cache and
routing strategies. Internal infrastructure (`retry.go`, `ratelimit.go`,
`cache.go`, SSE parsing, fallback/weighted routing) is safe to refactor.

## Docs

- docs/README.md — documentation index.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — system design, data flow, reliability features.
- docs/architecture/HOST-ENGINE-BOUNDARY.md — the frozen host-facing contract
  (v2): composition root, frozen symbols, credential flow, release order.
- docs/architecture/FEATURE-MONOREPO.md — feature-oriented package layout and
  layering rules.
- docs/architecture/DECENTRALIZED-RELAY.md — instance-local routing and signed
  peer manifests.
- docs/guides/CREDENTIAL-SETUP-FLOW.md — API keys, the credentials store, and
  provider setup.
- docs/guides/DYNAMIC-MODEL-DISCOVERY.md — live model discovery architecture.
- docs/design/RELAY-ENTERPRISE.md — draft enterprise gateway design.
- docs/plans/ — audit and review remediation plans from the 2026 code audit.

## Conventions

- Go 1.27.2+, pure Go, no CGO.
- Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`); no
  `Co-authored-by:` trailers (auto-stripped by githook).
- Branch from `main` (`feat/…`, `fix/…`, `chore/…`); never commit directly to
  `main`; PRs must be CI-green before merge.
- `VERSION` is the single version source; `make version-sync` regenerates
  derived metadata.
